title: Ad Creative Specs by Network
deck: Check submission requirements by network and placement, validate playable packages and inspect video overlays before delivery.
summary: Requirements depend on the network, placement and submission format. Do not apply a universal 5MB or 1.5-second rule. This is a pre-submission checklist, not a currently verified specification table. Check official documentation and the upload interface for the chosen placement, and record the date checked.

rows: Meta
Check ratio, duration and file size separately for Feed, Story and Reels
Compare the selected placement's ad guide and preview
TikTok
Check In-Feed and Spark submission formats, captions and CTA areas
Preview the actual text, profile and CTA
Google
Check image and video requirements by App campaign asset type
Compare asset diagnostics with Google Ads Help
Snap
Check ratio, duration and overlay areas for the chosen format
Check the upload interface and official format guide
AppLovin
Check playable packaging, file size and SDK/CTA integration
Run the submitted package through the network's validator

content.html: Start with the Meta Ads Guide and Google Ads Help. Record the format, placement and date checked rather than inferring limits from the network name alone.

items: File size: check the destination's limit and compressed versus uncompressed measurement. Do not treat 5MB as a universal network ceiling or an IAB-wide obligation.
Loading: test the submitted package on target devices and slow networks, measuring first display and first interaction. Do not claim 1.5 seconds is a universal rejection threshold.
Resources and SDK: check external-request permissions, packaging and install CTA integration in the network's documentation. Base64 inlining is not mandatory in every environment.
User actions: separate interaction instructions from the closing CTA and check for automatic clicks or redirects against the destination's policies.

content.html: Do not apply a fixed margin such as 15% to every placement. Use the selected placement's current template or actual ad preview with profile, captions and CTA; inspect whether titles, prices or legal disclosures are covered.

content.title: Playable rejected in network review
content.html: Preserve the original rejection message and submitted file version. Compare size measurement, format, duration, external requests and SDK integration with the destination's requirements. Fix the confirmed cause and rerun the same validator.

content.title: Key video info gets covered (TikTok)
content.html: Reproduce the overlay in the actual placement's preview. Vary device aspect ratio and language length, and record the template version. Where no preview is available, inspect actual rendering during a small initial campaign.
